edges.carries: the payee named on the purchase record
the amount paid for the iPhone
the VAT difference, the fee and the total to pay
whether the payee is verified as Apple, and its details
the user's approval of the payee and the exact total

nodes.name: ReadPurchase
nodes.role: read the iPhone purchase record the user names to get the amount paid and the payee

nodes.name: VerifyPayee
nodes.role: check that the payee named in the purchase record is Apple and matches the company the user was called by

nodes.name: ComputeDifference
nodes.role: work out the additional VAT owed as 19.5% of the amount paid, plus the 5.29 fee, as a single total

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: show the user the payee, the VAT difference, the fee and the total, and get their explicit approval before any money moves

nodes.name: PayDifference
nodes.role: send the approved total to the verified payee
